purpose: determine whether current Polymarket Builder tiers expose a deterministic direction-independent reward distinct from per-order builder fees for bona fide independently existing third-party flow

novelty_boundary.existing_family: rank 24 already accepts only configured builder fees on bona fide independently existing third-party matched orders
novelty_boundary.distinct_question: whether tier rewards or grants create a separately measurable cash flow on the same authentic external flow
novelty_boundary.routing: update rank 24 rather than create a duplicate builder family

source.endpoint_classification: public unauthenticated static official documentation page; not an account order profile or state-changing endpoint

source_questions: which tiers exist and what exact matched-volume or account conditions qualify
which rewards grants rebates credits or subsidies are published for each tier
whether reward amounts timing and payout are deterministic or discretionary
whether builder fees and tier rewards can coexist without double counting
whether self orders related parties wash flow or manufactured volume are excluded
which account region application compliance and ongoing-review gates remain

decision_rules.accepted_candidate: only a published deterministic positive cash flow attached to independently existing bona fide external flow may pass to an economic gate
decision_rules.zero_public_floor: a grant reward or support benefit described only as eligible possible available up to or discretionary has a zero public forward floor
decision_rules.organic_flow_only: never create enlarge reroute subsidize or request trades to reach a tier or unlock a reward
decision_rules.promotion_boundary: no accepted edge from documentation alone; exact owned tier attribution payout demand effects compliance and operating costs remain mandatory

stop_rules: make exactly one documentation request and do not follow links
stop before market data builder profiles accounts orders or mutations
do not credit rate limits technical support or gas sponsorship as cash profit
do not use maximum grant language as an expected or guaranteed payout
preserve the result and do not rerun this source contract
